parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the suitcase, typically made of durable plastic or rubber for comfort and strength.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the suitcase easily by hand.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot or fold down when not in use, providing flexibility and compactness.

parts.name: Belt (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is the adjustable belt or strap of the suitcase, made of strong woven nylon material.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to secure the suitcase or to carry it over the shoulder for convenience.
parts.Movement_description: It is flexible and can move freely, allowing adjustment in length and orientation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the suitcase, made of rigid polycarbonate for durability and impact resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary storage compartment, protecting the contents inside from external damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure that provides the overall shape and strength of the suitcase.
